notes: Purchases now flow through the books: every item bought counts in stock (untick Stock on a line for a service; Stock in Hand has a one-tap Count all purchases as stock for older bills), the supplier on a bill joins the Supplier contacts, and each credit bill shows what is still owed. New: Supplier Outstanding & Ageing (Purchases > Outstanding, Reports), + Payment to a supplier knocked off against bills, purchases and payables on the dashboard, stock in hand on the item list. Sales Report shows the buyer's name only and has a Columns button (GSTIN, state, phone, payment mode, PO no, items, CGST/SGST/IGST, received, outstanding, status) that Excel and PDF follow.
